arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent full-body cartoon sprite based on the FIRST image, an exact enlarged pixel-art pose. Do not trace pixel stairs. The standing feet/legs from the FIRST image must remain in their source stance, not the key's raised knee. Keep both hands and both feet. The other arm hangs close down against the side of the narrow turned torso. Rear/side overalls straps, not a frontal bib. Preserve original narrow legs with slight crossing and TWO separate offset shoes toward screen-right. Exactly two arms, two hands. Identity reference controls costume only, not the face direction.
